name: vLLM-TorchTPU compilation cache
description: Persist compiled artifacts and reduce repeated startup compilation.

assertions.assertion: vLLM-TorchTPU compilation cache provides official guidance on Persist compiled artifacts and reduce repeated startup compilation.
TorchTPU is the native PyTorch runtime replacing the deprecated PyTorch/XLA backend for TPU workloads.
vLLM-TorchTPU is the out-of-tree PyTorch-native serving backend for vLLM on TPUs, distinct from the JAX-native vllm-tpu backend.

qaPairs.question: What is vLLM-TorchTPU compilation cache used for in Cloud TPU workflows?
qaPairs.answer: Persist compiled artifacts and reduce repeated startup compilation.
